changeSet.author: kmarete
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE study_model, study_workspace, study_biospecimen IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE

INSERT INTO asset_catalog (asset_type, asset_number, model_id, backfill_run) SELECT 'MODEL', m.model_id, m.model_id, 'changelog-consent-2026-11-04-asset-catalog-assets' FROM study_model m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_catalog c WHERE c.model_id = m.model_id) ON CONFLICT (asset_type, asset_number) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO asset_catalog (asset_type, asset_number, workspace_id, backfill_run) SELECT 'WORKSPACE', w.workspace_id, w.workspace_id, 'changelog-consent-2026-11-04-asset-catalog-assets' FROM study_workspace w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_catalog c WHERE c.workspace_id = w.workspace_id) ON CONFLICT (asset_type, asset_number) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO asset_catalog (asset_type, asset_number, biospecimen_id, backfill_run) SELECT 'BIOSPECIMEN', b.biospecimen_id, b.biospecimen_id, 'changelog-consent-2026-11-04-asset-catalog-assets' FROM study_biospecimen b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset_catalog c WHERE c.biospecimen_id = b.biospecimen_id) ON CONFLICT (asset_type, asset_number) DO NOTHING

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM asset_catalog WHERE backfill_run = 'changelog-consent-2026-11-04-asset-catalog-assets' AND num_nonnulls(model_id, workspace_id, biospecimen_id) = 1 AND asset_removed_date IS NULL
